title: Wholesome Turkish Pilaf with Grapes
description: A flavorful and nutritious Turkish-inspired pilaf dish made with wholesome ingredients, served with sweet and tangy grapes on top.

ingredients.name: Grapes
ingredients.notes: any variety, such as red or green

ingredients.name: Turkish Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: a mix of cumin, coriander, and paprika

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: any variety, such as red or yellow

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add bulgur, Turkish spice blend, and pilaf. Stir to combine.
Add grape molasses (if using) and stir to coat the bulgur.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the bulgur is tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and top with halved grapes.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
